name: Withering Word
text: Once per round, lose 1 Sanity to add 3 dice to a fight.
flavor: A word that makes flesh forget how to hold together.

boosts.text: Speak the word: lose 1 Sanity for +3 dice.

name: Ward of Salt and Iron
text: Once per round, lose 1 Sanity to add 3 dice to a horror check.
flavor: A circle drawn quickly, in the old way.

boosts.text: Raise the ward: lose 1 Sanity for +3 dice against horror.

name: Veil of Mists
text: Once per round, lose 1 Sanity to add 3 dice when you evade.
flavor: The air thickens, and you are somewhere slightly to the left of where you were.

boosts.text: Call the mist: lose 1 Sanity for +3 dice to evade.

name: The Closing Sign
text: Once per round, lose 1 Sanity to add 3 dice when you seal a rift.
flavor: Five fingers, folded in an order that hurts.

boosts.text: Make the sign: lose 1 Sanity for +3 dice to seal.

name: Mend Flesh
text: Action: test Lore. If you pass, recover 3 Health. If you fail, lose 1 Sanity.
flavor: The wound closes. The scar is not quite your own skin.

action.text: Cast Mend Flesh: test Lore. Pass: recover 3 Health. Fail: lose 1 Sanity.

name: Clarity of the Lamp
text: Action: test Lore. If you pass, recover 2 Sanity.
flavor: Stare into the flame until the shadows stop moving.

action.text: Cast Clarity: test Lore. Pass: recover 2 Sanity.

name: Seeking Rite
text: Action: test Lore (-1). If you pass, gain 1 Clue. If you fail, lose 1 Sanity.
flavor: A needle on a thread, dangled over a map, and a name whispered three times.

action.text: Cast the Seeking Rite: test Lore (-1). Pass: gain 1 Clue. Fail: lose 1 Sanity.

name: Far Step
text: Action: test Lore. If you pass, move to any location up to 2 steps away. If you fail, lose 1 Sanity.
flavor: You step through a doorway that was not there, into a street you have never seen.

action.text: Cast Far Step: test Lore. Pass: move up to 2 steps. Fail: lose 1 Sanity.

name: Binding Chain
text: +1 Brawn in combat. Once per round, lose 1 Sanity to add 2 more dice to a fight.
flavor: Links of light that wrap around things with too many limbs.

boosts.text: Tighten the chain: lose 1 Sanity for +2 dice.

name: Speech of Dreams
text: Action: lose 1 Sanity and test Lore with 2 successes needed. If you pass, Doom retreats by 1. If you fail, lose 1 more Sanity.
flavor: You speak to the sleepers of the world, and ask them to dream a little longer.

action.text: Cast Speech of Dreams: lose 1 Sanity, then test Lore (2 successes). Pass: Doom retreats by 1. Fail: lose 1 Sanity.
